Sne takes two midterms, counts the best 2 out of 3 quizzes, and has a group report and presentation along with a group case study which was quite easy. During my time, she also gave a 3 mark bonus question. She is a bit strict when it comes to presentations and expects you to be properly prepared, but overall she is very supportive. I had an issue with my group during the course, and she solved the issue fairly.
She is also very transparent with grading. She calls everyone to her office and shows them the complete breakdown of the marks they received. I think she probably curved the whole class according to the overall class performance. You definitely do not need to oil her. In fact, she does not seem to like oiling at all. You can ask genuine questions if you actually need clarification, but avoid asking unnecessary questions just for the sake of it. Also avoid making unnecessary jokes during class if you want to stay on her good side.
For the exams, if you actually understand the topics, it is quite easy to do well. Her mcqs and written questions are not heavily focused on memorising specific answers, so understanding the concepts is enough to perform well. I personally did well in the course without having to study excessively. Overall, I had a really positive experience with her.

Mkt sne best of best
